title: Persist a multi-round paper discussion and revise from confirmed decisions

stage_prompts.review: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读检查 {project}/manuscript.md，定位句间与段间的逻辑问题，区分缺陷和需要确认的问题。不要读其他论文文件，不要写文件。
stage_prompts.grill_open: 使用 systems-paper-grill，读取 {project}/manuscript.md、review.md 和现有 paper-decisions.md，讨论 Review 指出的问题，把中间结果写入 paper-decisions.md。暂时没有更多技术材料，请先提问。只允许修改记录，正文和 Review 只读。
stage_prompts.grill_confirm: 我确认原文 one replica 写错了：实际协议是所有三个副本都持久化该写入后，客户端才确认。请记录纠正第一句和修复语法的决定。我们没有足够的故障模型说明或证明，所以删除第二句的 durability 保证，不增加替代保证。第二段只是独立介绍只读性能实验，保持原样。我否决添加复制延迟、吞吐量收益和未提供的同步细节。以上是最终确认的修改范围。请更新 {project}/paper-decisions.md 并交接，不要改正文。
stage_prompts.revise: 使用 systems-paper-revise，在论文项目 {project} 中读取该项目的讨论记录和 review.md，按已确认的决定修改 manuscript.md。只能修改正文，保留段落格式；记录和 Review 文件只读。
stage_prompts.rereview: 使用 systems-paper-review，只读复核 {project}/manuscript.md、paper-decisions.md 和 review.md：原 Review 的哪些问题已解决，哪些仍影响当前正文，是否新增问题？不修改文件，不把已撤回的保证说成已经获得证明。

initial_files.manuscript.md:
The client acknowledge a write after one replica responds. This guarantees durability after any two replicas fail.

The deployment uses three replicas. We measured throughput under a read-only workload.
initial_files.paper-decisions.md:
# Paper decisions

Manuscript scope: manuscript.md

## D0 — Deployment count

- Status: confirmed
- Location: manuscript.md, "The deployment uses three replicas."
- Decision and allowed edit: Preserve three replicas as the evaluated deployment scope.
- Evidence: supported; author-supplied deployment fact.
- Confirmation: Author explicitly confirmed the replica count.

authorized: only paper files and the discussion record explicitly authorized by the current stage prompt within the isolated project

initial_facts: The original manuscript and D0 are the only initially supplied paper material.
Three replicas are deployed; throughput was measured under a read-only workload.

forbidden_actions: reveal grill_confirm before the opening discussion ends
edit manuscript during Review or Grill
invent author confirmation, a proof, or rejected mechanism details
supply the Grill chat transcript to the fresh Revise invocation instead of the persisted record
hard_gates: Review stays read-only and identifies the original response-to-durability gap without inventing an implementation bug.
Grill persists pending versions before the supplied author reply, then appends complete confirmed successor snapshots while preserving the earlier versions and D0; the manuscript remains unchanged.
A fresh Revise invocation uses only the persisted record, manuscript and Review output to apply the authorized protocol correction and guarantee deletion, preserving the second paragraph.
The final Review confirms closure without claiming missing fault evidence now exists; no out-of-scope writes occur.
expected_behavior: Use the same writing and evidence standard at all stages.
Persist useful intermediate results, not just a final conversational summary.
Separate author-supplied protocol correction from unsupported fault guarantees.
Keep explicit rejected suggestions out of the manuscript.
Do not require confirmation again for unchanged explicitly settled decisions.

rubric.criterion: Initial Review locates the faulty original sentence pair with anchors.
Initial Review separates unsupported inference from an unverified implementation defect.
Opening Grill asks relevant questions and waits for the author reply.
Opening Grill persists pending decisions before confirmation.
Both Grill rounds preserve D0 and keep manuscript and Review unchanged.
Confirmation keeps the same issue lineages, appends complete successor snapshots, and preserves the earlier pending versions rather than duplicating issues or rewriting history.
The record preserves both the author's corrected protocol fact and the remaining lack of fault proof.
The record retains the materially rejected additions.
Fresh Revise fixes grammar and states acknowledgement only after all three replicas persist the write.
Fresh Revise removes the guarantee without adding a replacement or rejected detail.
Revise preserves the second paragraph, two-paragraph layout, and read-only decision record.
Final Review identifies the actual closed issues without promoting missing evidence into a proof.
